summary: Build stamps: watch packed-refs only when the branch ref HEAD names is not a loose file, and watch the directory the loose ref will appear in, so a branch that was packed by gc still sees its next commit

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this narrows and completes which Git files two build scripts tell Cargo to watch.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. The build stamp (revision, dirty flag) is computed exactly as before; only the files that trigger recomputing it change.

recovery.detail: No recovery procedure; reverting the change restores the previous build-script behavior.
